actual: EfficientGATs full-pool model memory is stable, but real QE GPU loops with variable daily GATs batches trigger PyTorch CUDA caching allocator fragmentation: allocated stays low while reserved grows to VRAM plus WDDM shared memory and OOMs. Inject PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True into QE GPU loop runtime commands so variable-size GPU NN loops use expandable segments. CPU loops must remain unaffected or the configured scope must be explicit. Add command-generation tests for GPU injection and CPU non-injection.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
description: EfficientGATs full-pool model memory is stable, but real QE GPU loops with variable daily GATs batches trigger PyTorch CUDA caching allocator fragmentation: allocated stays low while reserved grows to VRAM plus WDDM shared memory and OOMs. Inject PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True into QE GPU loop runtime commands so variable-size GPU NN loops use expandable segments. CPU loops must remain unaffected or the configured scope must be explicit. Add command-generation tests for GPU injection and CPU non-injection.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
